in_marathi.name: Sharvanya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Boons
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvanya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharvanya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sharva' which means 'Goddess of Boons' or 'Goddess of Wishes'. In Hindu mythology, Sharvana is considered to be a form of Goddess Saraswati, the Goddess of knowledge, music, arts, wisdom and learning. She is often depicted as a beautiful woman with four arms, holding a lotus, a book, a mala (rosary) and a bowl filled with knowledge.
